Reviewers must check against the printed SBLGNT and its apparatus whether verse 24 belongs in the text. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts.)

The SBLGNT apparatus shows that the SBLGNT prints verse 24 with the Robinson-Pierpont Byzantine text, while Westcott and Hort, Tregelles and NA28 leave it out and print 16:25-27 at this point. Codex Sinaiticus, Codex Alexandrinus, Codex Vaticanus and Codex Ephraemi lack verse 24 and have the doxology after 16:23; Codex Alexandrinus also has it after 14:23, and Papyrus 46 has it after 15:33.
Reviewers must check how the printed SBLGNT and its apparatus treat these verses, and whether its wording differs from Nestle 1904's. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts.)

The SBLGNT apparatus gives these verses, after 16:23-24, as the text of Westcott and Hort, Tregelles and NA28; that wording matches Nestle 1904's, except that Nestle 1904 ends with "to the ages of the ages" where the apparatus has "to the ages". Of the manuscripts pinned here, Codex Sinaiticus, Codex Alexandrinus, Codex Vaticanus and Codex Ephraemi have the doxology after 16:23, Codex Alexandrinus also after 14:23, and Papyrus 46 after 15:33; the Robinson-Pierpont Byzantine text has it after 14:23.
